message:
Hi everyone,
Was surprised to see T-NETIX again. This is a good time to contact your Senator or Congressman. On Tuesday of this week I went with the C.U.R.E. group to the Madison bldg at the Library of Congress where they met with congressional staffers asking them to take back to their leaders information to support the inmate telephone bill H.R 4466. This is a good time to contact them. Call the Capitol switchboard for the office of your Congressman or Senator. They will connect your call. Please everyone.

I complained to my Congressman about Secretary of the Maryland DOC and he requested an inquiry about the information that I gave. She still insist that Securus is the name of the company that Maryland contracts with. This is not true. The Assistant Commissioner sent my Congressman supporting her lie and sent me a copy. One week later my son was put in solitary. The charges were trumped up. I will be writing the Governor.

I have decided to send my information to the newspaper, I believe that some sort of corruption is going on in the DOC. The Maryland DBM clearly states that T-NETIX is the contractor.

T-Netix is going everywhere and doing underhanded things deliberately. The DOC's don't pay attention because they don't care.

If you live in Maryland and have your calls put on your Verizon bill please check to see that your bill statement fee is $1.95. The crooks charged me $2.49 on my March and April bills. I complained to the Maryland DBM about it and they had to put it back to $1.95. I am in dispute with them at the PSC about my credit. They lied to the DBM and said that Verizon was the cause of it. I contacated Verizon and they said that they are not authorized to make any corrections on T-NETIX bills. I am waiting the outcome.

Please complain to you public utility whatever state that you live in.

They are trying to hold us accountable for their policies for credit when they never explained them. You just look up one day and they say this is the way it is.
